title.narrative: Innovacin para Apoyar la Transicin Energtica y Accin Climtica en Uruguay .
Innovation to Support the Energy Transition and Climate Action in Uruguay

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir al crecimiento sostenible del pas a travs de latransicin energtica justa y la innovacin en el marco de los compromisos del Cambio Climtico (CC). Los objetivos especficos son: (i) contribuir a la descarbonizacin del sector transporte; (ii) apoyar el desarrollo de hidrgeno verde, con participacin privada a travs del aprovechamiento de los recursos de Energa Renovable (ER); y (iii) fortalecer el ecosistema de innovacin, desarrollo de capacidades, gnero y diversidad, y financiamiento para la Accin Climtica (AC).

The general objective of the program is to contribute to the sustainable growth of the country through the fair energy transition and innovation within the framework of Climate Change (CC) commitments. The specific objectives are: (i) contribute to the decarbonization of the transportation sector; (ii) support the development of green hydrogen, with private participation through the use of Renewable Energy (RE) resources; and (iii) strengthen the ecosystem of innovation, capacity development, gender and diversity, and financing for Climate Action (CA).
